notes.title: Patch 0.83 - Avatars & Upcoming Sale!
Patch 0.82 Major Update! The Electron world is alive!
notes.notes:
{ Down the Road }
Player avatar and NPC avatars are coming soon! We wanted a way to artfully represent a person in this electron world and I think we have some good stuff in the works.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39866814/9687ed86431249d4f10bad52ab9323c4820d8098.png
We are working hard at creating the next world you go to after New Zylon. We were going to make it another city, but be decided to do the Nexus next. The Nexus is part of the void between worlds that binds and connects everything together in Cyberspace, this electronic universe. 

{ New to Version 0.82 }
-- Pipes --
This next patch we made some major improvements and changes. The pipes in the world now come in from the void instead of above the city in the clouds which you have to fly up to. One person said it made them sick to suddenly we vaulted into the air 30 feet when the pipes came down. So since everyone doesn't have their VR legs we decided to not move the world, but just the pipes. It is a bit nicer to have the city close together now too, so we made it work.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39866814/fe124a357c673858bc0e193fc8b681128ad054b2.png
-- City / Graphics--
We also added a few more buildings to the city and another active conduit from the mainframe to the void. This is one closer to the defense building, so it adds more detail and life to the world. We also added some moving textures and electrons that float up in the world to make it feel more alive! We want to hold true to the art style without making it overly realistic. The whole point of old school virtual reality is sending you to another universe, not recreated reality again.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39866814/ce35088c167cd59a9ce19f3ed025da949e12dc6c.png

{ Patch Notes }
.82a1 - Working on Nexus World and Traveling to Nexus
.82a2 - Nexus world, working on pipes
.82a3 - More nexus pipes, moving textures for Zylon.
.82a4 - Major Update! Changed how pipes get moved into the world horizontally, rather than moving the entire world. We also added another conduit, moving textures for the main building, a few new city buildings, and particle effects to add to the cyberspace atmosphere.
.82a5 Working on player avatar and avatars for NPCs.

{ See you in the mainframe! }

notes.title: Patch 0.81 - State of the Game, Roadmap, & Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39866814/72a2819af59c53b3fbc36cf7339287b82f674679.png
{ Release State - Version 0.81D }
As of Early-Access release Cyber Defense is in early beta. 32 Levels +25 Hard mode levels are fully playable and most of the bugs have been ironed out. We will work a little more on balancing as reports come in, but we feel we are pretty close to our goals for weapons and turrets. 

{ Roadmap }
Moving ahead we have plans for at least 2 more worlds. After leaving New Zylon well defended you will be heading into the void to stop some direct attacks on the Nexus. The Nexus is the core of communications and deliveries between worlds and back to the real world. The 3rd world will be even more unique as you will be flying in between buildings, defending their mainframe and the infrastructure of the very city itself. These new worlds will bring a new type of gameplay and more challenges for the defender. 

{ Sale }
The EA sale will last a few more days, so don't forget to grab it soon!

notes.title: Summer Update! Version .66
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39866814/bb6043a03a045d652e340affe2d1eb6af55b0589.png
We have been making a lot of progress and are getting close to releasing to early access. We are shooting for June after the Steam Game Festival. We plan on having a full 32 levels in place for early access so it will be plenty of content to dive into. We also added a hard mode for levels 9+. We have added so much, an intro level, void levels which are like jumping/climbing puzzles to give player a variety from the standard game play and inject a little more story. We have 21 levels built and the first 16 heavily balanced and tested, including hard modes. 

We have many ways of winning and earning stars for all the levels as well. 100% wins get you full points for purchasing weapons/turrets and a gold star. If you mainframe takes damage, you don't get the gold star and only half the points, so it encourages you to try harder and has a lot of replayability. And of course if you lose, you lose some of those hard earned points. Most of the levels are randomized too, so outcomes will be different each time but some large attacks will be scripted so you can plan your turrets next time. Hardmode only rewards for 100% wins and offers more points for purchasing weapons/turrets. 

This will really be the first true tower defense shooter for VR where you are right in the middle of the action with full 6DOF movements, shooting and strategy. 

https://discord.gg/KjqcwYmZJ7
